text:
maria: Starting deploy window for v3.2.7 -> staging. Will watch SLO dash and alert routes. Deploybot initiating canary at 10% traffic. tagging @kai FYI.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: v3.2.7 -> staging | canary 10% | id: db-1745001234 | logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/build/1745 :rocket:

kai: Thanks. I’ll monitor p95/p99 latency and 5xx. Ran a quick query: current p95 generate <=120ms baseline. alert thresholds set: p95>200ms, 5xx rate>0.5%.

violet: Heads-up: Synthetic checks might flake during migration of embed service. I disabled noisy synthetic in the SLO panel for canary window (reason: known transient).

sam: Noted. I’ll keep an eye on error budget burn. If 5xx spike > 0.7% for 3min, we rollback automatically (per runbook).

lee: Seeing small KV cache warmup bump in latency on a few pods: tail logs show repeated `kvcache: cold miss` but errors=0. Pinning new model variant on canary to reduce memory churn.

maria: Can you pin the canary to model v2-quant? We want predictable perf. @deploy-bot pin version v2-quant to canary id db-1745001234

deploy-bot: pin applied: model=v2-quant | canary=db-1745001234 | new config: batching=auto, cache_prefill=on

kai: Alert: p95 climbed to 210ms on canary at 1745001305, 5xx still 0.12% — marking as watch. Manual hold for 5 mins while we observe.

lee: I’m pulling logs from the affected slice. Looks like one pod had GC spike. Restarting that pod now.

ops-bot: pod restart completed: pod/runtime-7f8a | restart_ts=1745001320

kai: p95 back to 115ms after restart. 5xx steady. Removing hold, proceed to ramp to 30% in 5m.

maria: Proceeding. Note: we recorded the incident in release notes draft. Add short blurb about kvcache warmup + GC bump.

violet: I’ll add observability note and schedule a follow-up to add cache prefill metric to SLO dashboard.

sam: Good. Closing canary watch. Will set a post-deploy check to run perf regression tests in 1h.
